author: val
body: The offsets are MINUTES because a sixth of the world does not live on a whole hour. India is +05:30, Nepal +05:45, Chatham +12:45, and a design that cannot say those cannot say where those people are.

author: val
body: THE ID IS THE INDEX PLUS ONE, so that zero can mean "no zone chosen, just an offset". A stored zero is what a machine that only ever had a `CTZ1` record has, and it must not read as Midway.
